name: AI 3D Studio
release_notes: New: AI mesh commands in chat — analyze mesh stats, simplify/reduce faces, separate multi-body 3MF into individual STLs. Multi-body 3MF simplification decimates each body proportionally and reassembles into a _simplified.3mf. Fix: mesh commands now work correctly with paths containing spaces. Fix: all bodies in a multi-body 3MF are now processed (was only loading first body). Docs: added AI Mesh Commands section to User Guide and Help.
